articles.summary: Appointment strengthens focus on guest experience, menu innovation and profitable growth Lucky Strike Entertainment (NYSE: LUCK) today announced the appointment of Patrick Chung as Executive Vice President of Food Beverage Operations. Chung will lead the Company’s food and beverage operations, with a focus on enhancing the guest experience, strengthening execution and driving profitable growth. “Food and beverage should be a reason guests choose Lucky Strike, not simply something they order once they arrive,” said Thomas Shannon, Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Lucky Strike Entertainment. “Patrick brings a compelling combination of hospitality experience, analytical discipline and a passion for understanding what guests want. Our focus is straightforward: deliver food and drinks our guests love, offer great value and execute consistently. Patrick will help us translate that vision into better menus, stronger performance and more reasons for guests to come back.”
articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Appoints Patrick Chung Executive Vice President of Food & Beverage Operations

articles.summary: Bowlmor Cupertino becomes Lucky Strike Cupertino, carrying forward the legacy of the brand that started it all Lucky Strike Entertainment (NYSE: LUCK), one of the world's premier owner-operators of location-based entertainment destinations, announced today that Bowlmor Cupertino has been rebranded as Lucky Strike Cupertino, marking the transition of the company’s final operating Bowlmor location. The milestone celebrates the brand that first turned bowling into a night out and marks the next chapter for a company that continues to grow as more people rediscover the lanes. The new Lucky Strike Cupertino location arrives just in time for holiday party season, giving Bay Area companies, teams and groups a new destination for year-end celebrations. Bowlmor Lanes opened in New York City's Greenwich Village in the 1930s and became a beloved neighborhood institution. articles.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment (NYSE: LUCK), one of the world’s premier operators of location-based entertainment, will report financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 on Thursday, November 5, 2026, before the U.S. stock market opens. Management will discuss the results via webcast at 9:00 AM ET on the same day. The live webcast, replay, and results presentation will be available in the Events Presentations section of the Lucky Strike Entertainment Investor Relations website at IR.LuckyStrikeEnt.com . About Lucky Strike Entertainment Lucky Strike Entertainment is one of the world’s premier location-based entertainment platforms. With over 360 locations across North America, Lucky Strike Entertainment provides experiential offerings in bowling, amusements, water parks, and family entertainment centers.
